brief:
Israeli authorities have uncovered involvement by military personnel and private contractors in the theft of millions of shekels from central Gaza, Ma'an news agency reported. The investigation revealed systematic embezzlement during operations in the territory, implicating both official forces and contracted companies in the scheme.

The case marks a rare public disclosure of alleged corruption within Israeli military and security operations. Authorities have opened criminal proceedings against those implicated in the theft.
title: Israel charges military personnel and contractors with stealing millions from Gaza operations
